target: USA HeartGold first; USA SoulSilver separately validated

features.name: Game speed: 1x / 1.5x / 2x / 3x / 4x
features.base_heartgold: Normal DS timing.
features.required_work: Use melonDS fast-forward initially; a matching in-game speed menu is separate work, with DS hardware limits.

features.name: Real-time pacing
features.base_heartgold: Native DS audio/timing, not the Emerald 3DS DSP-clock implementation.
features.required_work: Use emulator audio/timing controls; do not transplant the 3DS-specific pacing code into DS.

features.name: EXP for catching
features.base_heartgold: Not present.
features.required_work: Integrate hg-engine capture EXP; validate capture, level-up, evolution and double-battle paths.

features.name: Party-wide EXP Share
features.base_heartgold: Held-item EXP Share only; not party-wide.
features.required_work: Add optional full EXP for participants, half for other eligible party members; skip eggs/fainted/empty slots; prevent held-item double rewards.

features.name: Trade evolutions at level 40
features.base_heartgold: Trade requirements remain.
features.required_work: Add level-up alternative at level >=40; held trade items still required and consumed only after successful evolution. Retain normal trades.

features.name: Field moves without learning the move
features.base_heartgold: Party must know the field move.
features.required_work: Preserve badges/story checks; adapt to HGSS Cut, Fly, Surf, Strength, Whirlpool, Rock Smash, Waterfall and Rock Climb. Flash is a TM in HGSS; Dive is not an HGSS field HM.

features.name: Visible wild Pokemon: Off / Few / Some / Many
features.base_heartgold: Random grass/cave/water encounters plus specific scripted overworld Pokemon; no general roaming-spawn system.
features.required_work: Priority 1: dynamic visible encounters, 0/2/4/6 slots, grass first then cave/water; only Many replaces ordinary step encounters. See encounter specification.

features.name: IV / EV summary viewer
features.base_heartgold: Stats shown; exact IVs/EVs not exposed as a summary page.
features.required_work: Integrate hg-engine summary viewer and optional enable/disable control.

features.name: Use another Repel prompt
features.base_heartgold: Wear-off message without this option.
features.required_work: Adapt hg-engine repel prompt: its current code prioritizes Max/Super/normal instead of Emerald's same-last-type behavior; exact parity needs that change.

features.name: Reusable TMs
features.base_heartgold: TMs consumed; HMs reusable.
features.required_work: Milestone 01 patches the teaching-consumption call in both USA Visual+ full builds; ARM instruction tests pass. Full teaching-flow validation, bag count presentation and runtime toggle remain.

features.name: Running indoors
features.base_heartgold: Indoor running is native; map-header runningAllowed is unused. Scripted movement restrictions still apply.
features.required_work: Retain HGSS behavior; do not bypass cutscene or movement locks to imitate the Emerald switch.

features.name: Physical / special move split
features.base_heartgold: Native Gen IV mechanic, with move categories.
features.required_work: Keep HGSS mechanics; no conversion needed. Emerald's optional Gen III fallback is not needed for baseline HGSS.

features.name: Day / night outdoor lighting
features.base_heartgold: Native time-of-day lighting and windows; its artwork differs from Emerald's lighting.
features.required_work: Keep HGSS native lighting. An Off/Auto override and exact Emerald-style extra lighting would be new optional work.

features.name: World clock: 1x / 6x / 12x / 24x / 60x / 120x
features.base_heartgold: Uses real RTC; no independent accelerated world clock.
features.required_work: Add separate clock with save-safe persistence. Specify effects on lighting, encounter tables and Berry Pots without triggering RTC tamper penalties or fast-forwarding daily events.

features.name: Morning / day / night wild encounter tables
features.base_heartgold: Native time-dependent HGSS encounters.
features.required_work: Preserve Johto/Kanto tables and modifiers; do not copy Hoenn species tables. Off/Timed override would be additional UI.

features.name: Show clock on map / bottom-screen HUD
features.base_heartgold: Clock exists in Pokegear; not Emerald's always-visible map clock.
features.required_work: Add optional field/map HUD clock and speed indication; retain Pokegear clock.

features.name: Lead Pokemon follower
features.base_heartgold: Native follower, interaction, cries, animations and held leaves/accessory-related behavior.
features.required_work: Retain native system; optional Off/On menu and any Emerald-specific item-finding rules need separate adaptation.

features.name: Encounter rate: Normal / Off / quarter / half / double
features.base_heartgold: Normal game encounter-rate modifiers only.
features.required_work: Optional rate control must cover random encounter chance and visible spawn cadence; Off removes visible spawns too. Keep fishing, scripted and legendary paths separate.

features.name: Shiny odds: 1/8192, 1/4096, 1/1024, 1/256, 1/64, always
features.base_heartgold: Original odds and fixed scripted exceptions.
features.required_work: Runtime selection for new eligible player Pokemon; roll once at visible spawn and preserve PID/shininess into battle. hg-engine SHINY_ODDS is only a compile-time starting point.

features.name: Always catch
features.base_heartgold: Normal catch calculations.
features.required_work: Optional guaranteed catch restricted to eligible wild battles; never steal trainer Pokemon or bypass special battle rules.

features.name: Instant victory
features.base_heartgold: Normal battle flow.
features.required_work: Optional instant fainting via normal battle bookkeeping; exclude link/facility/tutorial battles and preserve rewards/scripts.

features.name: Fast egg hatching
features.base_heartgold: Original egg cycles and ability effects.
features.required_work: Optional one-cycle/fast-hatch behavior through native daycare and hatch queue, without modifying non-eggs.

features.name: Infinite money
features.base_heartgold: Normal balance.
features.required_work: Optional full balance through native capped money API; do not alter casino coins/Battle Points.

features.name: Complete regional Pokedex
features.base_heartgold: Normal Johto Pokedex progression.
features.required_work: Adapt Hoenn action to Johto seen/caught entries using native form/dex bookkeeping; label it Johto, not Hoenn.

features.name: Unlock National Pokedex
features.base_heartgold: Normal story unlock.
features.required_work: Optional action using HGSS dex upgrade API; avoid altering story completion flags.

features.name: Complete National Pokedex
features.base_heartgold: Normal progression.
features.required_work: Optional native seen/caught operation for HGSS species; no automatic expansion beyond the base dex.

features.name: Item giver: pocket, item, quantity, give
features.base_heartgold: Normal bag acquisition.
features.required_work: Add field-only item UI, valid item filtering, capacities and unique key-item checks; adapt all HGSS pockets. Quantities 1/5/10/50/99.

features.name: 3D overworld / voxel toggle
features.base_heartgold: Already uses 3D environment geometry and 2D character sprites.
features.visual_plus: Camera changes expose more existing geometry.
features.required_work: Keep native HGSS maps. An exact voxel replacement and classic/voxel toggle would require a separate renderer and asset pipeline.

features.name: Adjustable 3D camera angle
features.base_heartgold: Native camera.
features.visual_plus: Full or 50%-blended camera table chosen at build time.
features.required_work: Preserve Visual+ camera; runtime angle selector and map-specific corrections are additional work.

features.name: Adjustable 3D camera zoom
features.base_heartgold: Native fixed/game-controlled distances.
features.required_work: Add bounded camera distances and field-menu control; test culling and map transitions.

features.name: 3D tilt-shift blur: Off / 10-100%
features.base_heartgold: No equivalent user-selectable postprocess.
features.required_work: Requires new DS rendering effect or emulator shader; DS VRAM/fill-rate feasibility must be measured.

features.name: Battles over the rendered overworld
features.base_heartgold: Separate battle scenes with Pokemon sprites, not battles in the live field map.
features.required_work: Major rendering/camera integration; Visual+ backgrounds do not implement this. Pokemon remain sprites in Emerald too.

features.name: Stereoscopic world: Auto / On / Off
features.base_heartgold: DS screens are not stereoscopic.
features.required_work: Cannot provide native 3DS stereoscopy in an NDS ROM. Would require a different platform/renderer, not a DS patch.

features.name: Stereoscopic depth: 25-200%
features.base_heartgold: No stereoscopic depth slider.
features.required_work: Not applicable to native NDS hardware; emulator-specific stereo would be a separate project.

features.name: Show FPS
features.base_heartgold: No player-facing FPS counter.
features.required_work: Use melonDS FPS display; an in-game counter would be separate instrumentation.

features.name: Run without holding B
features.base_heartgold: Native touchscreen running-shoes lock.
features.required_work: Retain native running toggle.

features.name: Quick ball throw, remembered ball and cycling
features.base_heartgold: Bag/battle item interface, not Emerald's R-button + dedicated cycling plate.
features.required_work: Add optional one-button throw and ball selection; single eligible wild battles only; retain last choice, validate bag stock and storage.

features.name: Touchscreen field menus: party, bag, save, options, dex
features.base_heartgold: Native dual-screen touch menus for those functions.
features.required_work: Keep HGSS interface rather than replace it with Hoenn-specific layouts.

features.name: Touch battle commands and move details
features.base_heartgold: Native touch battle menu and move categories/details.
features.required_work: Keep native battle UI; exact Emerald move-button typography/graphics would be new UI work.

features.name: Touchscreen shop / bag quantity controls
features.base_heartgold: Native DS shop/bag interfaces.
features.required_work: Functional shopping is present; Emerald's particular touch-drag quantity interaction would need a UI rewrite.

features.name: Trainer / badges / party save overview
features.base_heartgold: Native save confirmation and trainer/party screens.
features.required_work: Exact combined Emerald save card would be a new optional UI.

features.name: Touchscreen map, Pokedex and regional units
features.base_heartgold: Pokegear map, native Pokedex and region-specific presentation.
features.required_work: Keep HGSS equivalents; no Hoenn-specific table or translation fixes needed.

features.name: HD battle information / text boxes
features.base_heartgold: DS native screens are 256x192 each; Emerald 3DS top screen is 400x240.
features.required_work: Cannot obtain 400x240 native UI from DS hardware. Emulator upscaling improves rendered 3D but does not automatically redraw 2D text.

features.name: 400-pixel field, effects, transitions and cutscenes
features.base_heartgold: DS native aspect and resolution.
features.required_work: Use a separately validated emulator widescreen hack if desired; Emerald's per-scene widening code is not applicable.

features.name: Local trading / battling / multiplayer activities
features.base_heartgold: Native DS local wireless, Union Room and game-specific minigames/facilities.
features.required_work: Retain DS protocols and activities; test emulator networking separately. Hoenn-only Berry Blender/contests are not HGSS content.

features.name: Soft reset
features.base_heartgold: Native DS soft reset.
features.required_work: Retain existing reset path and release transient encounter state on reset.

features.name: Persistent enhancement / cheat settings pages
features.base_heartgold: Native options save only the original settings.
features.required_work: Add optional settings UI and versioned persistence. Decide between audited save expansion and flashcart/emulator sidecar; do not assume arbitrary save bytes are unused.

features.name: Follower talk / cries / animations / item finding
features.base_heartgold: Native follower interaction system is richer in some areas but has different item rules.
features.required_work: Keep native interactions, shiny/forms and transitions; audit item-finding differences before adding any Emerald-specific behavior.

features.name: English / Spanish / French / Italian build variants
features.base_heartgold: We have clean USA English HG and SS; official other-language HGSS ROMs are separate.
features.visual_plus: English port of a Korean visual mod, not translation of the entire game.
features.required_work: English target is already native. Additional languages need their own ROMs, hooks and validation; do not apply USA offsets across regions.

features.name: Build game data locally from the user ROM
features.base_heartgold: NDS ROM embeds its data, unlike Emerald's 3DSX + pack.
features.visual_plus: xdelta patches use the clean USA ROM.
features.required_work: Keep local ROM-to-patched-NDS workflow, checksum verification and original ROM preservation; no Emerald PAK needed.

features.name: Preserve existing saves
features.base_heartgold: HGSS has its own DS save format.
features.required_work: Prove compatibility for every new setting and feature; do not claim Emerald .sav or GBA save compatibility with HGSS.

features.name: 3DS Home Menu forwarder / Homebrew Launcher
features.base_heartgold: NDS application, not a native 3DSX.
features.required_work: Use melonDS on Mac or an appropriate DS loader on hardware; Emerald's CIA/Luma launcher and DSP firmware instructions do not apply.

features.name: Text speed
features.base_heartgold: Native text speed option.
features.required_work: No enhancement implementation needed.

features.name: Battle animations
features.base_heartgold: Native battle-scene option.
features.required_work: No enhancement implementation needed.

features.name: Battle style: Shift / Set
features.base_heartgold: Native battle-style option.
features.required_work: No enhancement implementation needed.

features.name: Sound: mono / stereo
features.base_heartgold: Native sound option.
features.required_work: No enhancement implementation needed.

features.name: Button mode / L=A
features.base_heartgold: Native button-mode option; control mappings differ by platform.
features.required_work: No enhancement implementation needed.

features.name: Message window frame
features.base_heartgold: Native frame selection; artwork differs by game.
features.required_work: No enhancement implementation needed.
